items.label: Window: subsidies still open
items.text: Local money is first come, first served: help buyers claim it

items.label: Purchase tax
items.note: Halved in 2026 and 2027, no cliff at year end

items.label: Trade-in
items.note: Scrappage subsidy, maxed out near a RMB 167k price

items.label: Local subsidies
items.note: Such as 14,000 slots in Shanghai's Pudong

footnote: Source: MOF/STA No. 10 of 2023, NDRC/MOF No. 1745 of 2025, Shanghai government, MOFCOM (Sep 2026)
notes: There is no purchase-tax cliff at year end, but there is a subsidy deadline: central trade-in money not spent by December 31 goes back to the central budget, and most local subsidies run on first come, first served. That may pull some sales into October and November, but no data puts a number on it, so we do not build it into the volume plan. We treat it as the window for promotions and store actions. Replacing an old car without scrapping it pays 8%, up to RMB 15,000. The third tranche of RMB 62.5bn in central funds went out before the end of June, and we have found no Q4 tranche as of October 3.
